Samenvatting Looking for a logistics job where you can learn quickly and make a real difference? As a Warehouse Employee Supply Chain DHL in Kampen, you’ll join a modern team, receive full training, and help keep the global flow of spare parts moving. Work in a modern warehouse with clear rules, good working conditions, and real opportunities for long-term cooperation. Good work!Over de functieAs a warehouse worker, you will be part of a team responsible for handling and shipping spare parts worldwide. The work is dynamic and physical, ideal for active people who like to stay on the move.
You will work in a 2-shift system:
- 06:00–15:00
- 15:00–23:00
with occasional night shifts (21:00–06:00).

At the location in Kampen, you will work in a dynamic and well-organized warehouse environment where teamwork, mutual respect, and trust are highly valued.

- good knowledge of English or Dutch
- willingness to work in shifts
- good physical condition, flexibility, and willingness to learn
- warehouse experience or EPT operation is an advantage

- Shift allowances and overtime paid at 150%
- 2-shift system (06:00–15:00 / 15:00–23:00) + occasional night shifts (21:00–06:00)
- Travel allowance: €0.23/km (up to €9.30 per day)
- 6-week paid training and full onboarding
- Employment with a global logistics leader – DHL

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

jobs.occupation: Front Office Team Leader - Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam
jobs.description:
At Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam, we believe that every stay should be memorable. Located opposite Amsterdam Central Station, our hotel combines genuine hospitality with exceptional service, creating meaningful moments for every guest. As our Front Office Team Leader, you will be at the heart of the guest journey, leading by example and ensuring every arrival, stay, and departure exceeds expectations.
Your smile, professionalism, and passion for service will inspire both guests and colleagues alike, helping create the welcoming atmosphere Park Plaza is known for.
Are you the perfect match?

• Your biggest motivator is exceeding guests' expectations and delivering outstanding service.
• Creating a warm welcome, managing guest requests, and ensuring smooth check-ins and check-outs are second nature to you.
• You are a natural people person with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• You enjoy coaching, mentoring, and motivating colleagues to deliver their best performance.
• You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can confidently lead shifts while maintaining exceptional service standards.
• Flexibility is no issue for you; you're happy to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
• Hospitality is in your DNA.
• You communicate confidently in English; additional languages are a plus.
• You have experience working with Property Management Systems (Opera experience is advantageous).
• You share our values: Trust, Respect, Teamwork, Enthusiasm, Commitment & Care.
• Ideally, you have previous experience as a Front Office Supervisor, Front Office Team Leader, or similar leadership role within a hotel environment.

Excited? We have more to share!
Benefits of working with us as a Front Office Team Leader:

• Birthday bonus of €250 (gross, paid in the month of your birthday)
• Competitive salary
• Tasty meal during your shift
• Industry pension plan
• 25 days holiday
• 1 extra day off for your wellbeing
• Exciting career opportunities wit

Main Responsibilities of the role:
Sorting received materials and checking them for accuracy, quality, and requested quantities.

Team player.

Our client is a global leader in medicines, dedicated to creating a healthy world. Through their vaccines, biologics, and medicines, they provide innovative treatments to improve the health of people and animals in more than 140 countries. They focus on conditions that severely impair daily functioning or are life-threatening, and for which new medicines are needed. Our client is also a pioneer in biologics research and development for animal health.

At our client, they believe in the power of diversity within teams of talented employees at all levels. Preparation and formulation of vaccines and pharmaceutical products.
Working with fixed and mobile brewing kettles up to 5000 liters.
Preparation, control and release of raw materials, filters and materials.
Execution of CIP and SIP processes on plants and equipment.
Registration of process steps and checks according to GMP and GDP guidelines.
Identifying and resolving deviations and process disruptions.
Collaborating with colleagues from production, quality, planning and technical operations.
Contributing to improvement projects and optimizations within the department.

You love technology, processes and quality. You work accurately, take responsibility and enjoy achieving results together.

Interest in engineering, process technology or pharmaceutical production.
A proactive and inquisitive attitude.
Good communication skills.
An eye for quality, safety and detail.
Experience within GMP, pharmaceuticals, food or process industry is a plus, but not a requirement.
